tool_arguments.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Fresh standalone full-body transparent illustration of the EXACT adopted Sakhalin taimen in image1, the sole identity/style/anatomy/proportion reference. Do not edit source pixels. One left-facing fish in its same horizontal rounded short body, olive-brown spotted back, pale cream/pink belly, solid brown dot eye without glint, open friendly small mouth, warm clean brown contour and gentle bounded watercolor paper grain. Highest native resolution, preferably landscape1536x1024, generous transparent margins.
POSE present_left: the existing near pectoral fan fin (the single large fan immediately behind its gill) extends gently FORWARD toward viewer LEFT to present something outside the picture. Move THIS SAME fin, do not duplicate it. Its old down/right pointing position must be absent. Keep only the reference TWO other lower fins farther behind it: one pelvic fan under mid-belly and one smaller anal fin nearer the tail. Therefore exactly3 visible low/front fin projections TOTAL: 1forward-presenting pectoral +1mid-belly pelvic +1posterior anal. NOT three extra fans under the belly. Keep exactly one dorsal back fin, one small adipose bump behind dorsal, one complete two-lobed tail. Natural connected fish appendages, no hands/fingers/arms, no extra far pectoral fin shown for this side-view pose. Preserve head-to-trunk ratio, trunk height/thickness/length and tail size; body does not become taller or shorter to fit. Show entire fish with no cut extremity. No props, ground, water, shadows, glow, clouds, labels, text, frame or backdrop; actual transparent alpha. No detached pigment scraps, duplicated fins, blur, color smears or clipping.
